title: GT24
overview: GT24 is an arcade-style racing game and a modified port of the 1996 arcade game Super GT 24h. It features one new track for a total of three in both regular and reverse configurations, two new vehicles for a total of six, and five different pit crews. Three game modes are included: Time Trial, Grand Prix, and a 24-hour Endurance race mode (which can be configured as 12, 24, or 48 minutes real time) that includes a full day/night cycle that changes as the race progresses.
